sloka: तं समुत्सृज्य सा शक्तिः सौमित्रिं युधि दुर्जयम् ।रावणस्य रथे तस्मिन् स्थानं पुनरुपागता ।। ६.५९.१२१ ।।।।
transliteration: taṁ samutsṛjya sā śaktiḥ saumitriṁ yudhi durjayam ।rāvaṇasya rathe tasmin sthānaṁ punarupāgatā ।। 6.59.121 ।।।।

translations.english: That power returned back to Ravana's chariot to its position, leaving Lakshmana, who was difficult to vanquish.
